verdict.rationale: Vercel Agent is a first-party AI assistant built into Vercel. It draws on the user's projects, deployments, logs, metrics, configuration and usage to investigate production issues, and it validates code before suggested changes reach production. That directly matches AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's data inside the product. However, these surfaces are documented only as public beta limited to Pro and Enterprise teams, and the docs give little detail on what the insights look like. missing for 10: general availability across plans, detailed documentation of the insight/suggestion outputs (e.g., proactive recommendations on analytics or usage data), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Vercel Agent is an AI assistant built into Vercel. Use it to understand your projects, investigate production issues, review code, and take approved actions.
Vercel Agent uses context from your Vercel projects, deployments, logs, metrics, configuration, usage, and connected repositories.
Chat in Slack, dashboard chat, Investigations, and Code Review are in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams.
